title: Work tape representation of a field record
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration of a $K$-tape Turing machine, let $r$ index one of its work tapes, and let $F$ be a finite list of finite lists of tape symbols. We say that $d$ represents $F$ on tape $r$ if, for every integer $p$ with $-1 \le p \le |\operatorname{join}(F)|$, the symbol or blank stored on tape $r$ at the position $p$ units from its head equals the tape content specified by $F$ at offset $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration of a $K$-tape Turing machine
$r$ is an index among the $K$ work tapes
$F$ is a finite list of finite lists of tape symbols
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definitions of joining fields or the tape contents they specify, so their precise conventions cannot be stated here.
